wargear.name: Night-mantle
wargear.summary: A cloak of dark, light-eating fabric stitched with something that was once a man's hide.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Night-mantle has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Gibbet standard
wargear.summary: A frame that carries the last enemy officer the unit caught, still in his armour.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Gibbet standard, all Models in that Unit have the Hatred (Infantry) Special Rule. If the Model carrying the Gibbet standard is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Siren harness
wargear.summary: A scream-tuned jump pack rig that howls on the descent.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Siren harness gives its Unit the Howling Dive Special Rule.

wargear.name: Atrocity trophies
wargear.summary: A rack of enemy standards, helms and banners.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Atrocity trophies has the Trophy of Terror Special Rule.

wargear.name: Whisper-warded fetish
wargear.summary: Knotted hair, bone and a murmured curse against the warp.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Whisper-warded fetish adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and has the Hexed Mind Special Rule.

wargear.name: Headsman's chain
wargear.summary: A weighted chain hung with the badges of men executed.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Headsman's chain has the Headsman's Reckoning Special Rule.

wargear.name: Grapnel lines
wargear.summary: Wire-line launchers for taking walls and rooftops in a heartbeat.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Grapnel lines gives its Unit the Rooftop Stalkers Special Rule.

wargear.name: Murk-smoke projectors
wargear.summary: Vents that pour oily dark behind the hull.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Murk-smoke projectors has the Murk Shroud Special Rule.

wargear.name: Wailing warsiren
wargear.summary: A hull-mounted siren tuned to the pitch of a dying man.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Wailing warsiren has the Dirge of Dread Special Rule.

wargear.name: Gallows-rope of Nostramo
wargear.summary: A hangman's noose, knotted once for every sentence he has carried out.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Gallows-rope of Nostramo has the Sentence Passed Special Rule.

wargear.name: Shard of the Foreseen
wargear.summary: A sliver of black glass in which the bearer glimpses the last moment of the fight.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Shard of the Foreseen has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Mask of the Wailing City
wargear.summary: A grinning mask fitted with a throat of brass reeds, made to scream like the dying hive.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Mask of the Wailing City has the Wail of the Unforgiven Special Rule.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a murderer's weapon
The Headsman may take a Headsman's axe
Up to two models may take a Darkscope bolter
Up to four models may carry a Banshee pistol
The Sergeant may wear a Night-mantle
The unit may carry a Gibbet standard
The Sergeant may fit a Siren harness
The unit may carry Grapnel lines
The Sergeant may wear a Headsman's chain
Cabal Reliquary: may take up to two relics
May take a Night Lords vehicle fitting
Up to two models may carry a Hook-chain flail
Up to two models may carry a Hook-chain flail
One model may carry a Dread-screamer
The Sergeant may take a Garrote-wire gauntlet
Aspect of the Primarch: Konrad Curze may take one
Relics of the Primarch: Konrad Curze may take one

modifiers.text: Night Raptors strike from above and are hit back: +1 I, -1 T.
Terror Squads revel in it and fear it: +1 WS, -1 CL.
The Flay-clade want the knife, not the gun: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Contekar, bitter and unbound: +1 A, -1 LD.
Prophet of the Foreseen Fall: -1 WP, -1 LD.

rules.name: Silent Knives
rules.summary: The sentry never saw the blade.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that arrives from Reserves cannot be the target of Reaction Shooting Attacks made by enemy Units during the Battle Turn in which it arrives.

rules.name: Dread Herald
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Charge, each enemy Unit it charges subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic for any Cool Check it makes until the end of that Assault phase. This is in addition to any effect of the Fear (X) Special Rule.

rules.name: Judgement of the Cabal
rules.summary: The Cabal names its victim before the first shot is fired.
rules.text: Before Deployment, the Controlling Player chooses one enemy Unit to be the Condemned. Hit Tests made by Models with this Special Rule against the Condemned Unit are made with a +1 modifier. When the Condemned Unit is destroyed, the Controlling Player chooses a new Condemned Unit at the start of their next Battle Turn.

rules.name: Tithe of Blood
rules.summary: The Eighth Legion takes its tithe in fear.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule destroys an enemy Unit in an Assault, each enemy Unit within 12" of it subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Howling Dive
rules.summary: The wail of the dive grinds nerves to powder.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that has declared a Charge is hit at -1 in Reaction Shooting Attacks made against it. Each enemy Unit it charges also subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic for Cool Checks made during that Charge.

rules.name: Trophy of Terror
rules.summary: Every banner on the rack was taken from someone who thought they were safe.
rules.text: Friendly Night Lords Units within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule add 1 to their Cool Characteristic. Enemy Units within 6" of that Model subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic.

rules.name: Hexed Mind
rules.summary: A mind knotted shut against the warp.
rules.text: Psychic Checks made for enemy psychic powers that target a Model with this Special Rule, or its Unit, are made with a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Headsman's Reckoning
rules.summary: Every execution is a lesson to those who watch.
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule wins a Challenge, or destroys an enemy Sergeant or Command Model in an Assault, each enemy Unit within 9" subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the start of its Controlling Player's next Battle Turn.

rules.name: Rooftop Stalkers
rules.summary: They come over the walls, not through the gates.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the effects of Difficult Terrain when it makes a Charge. If a Unit with this Special Rule crosses or ends its Charge move in terrain, a Charge Roll of less than 6 is treated as a 6.

rules.name: Murk Shroud
rules.summary: The hull vanishes into its own dark.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule during any Battle Turn in which it moved.

rules.name: Dirge of Dread
rules.summary: A dying man's note, held for as long as the engine runs.
rules.text: At the end of the Movement phase, each enemy Unit within 12" of a Vehicle with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: The Night Haunter
rules.summary: The terror of Nostramo walks in the open, and his own sons give him room.
rules.text: This Model loses the Fear (2) Special Rule and has the Fear (3) Special Rule. Friendly Night Lords Units within 6" of this Model subtract 1 from their Leadership Characteristic.

rules.name: Prophet of the Foreseen Fall
rules.summary: He has seen the blow that will end him, and so he sees every other blow first.
rules.text: Once in each Battle Turn, when an enemy Unit declares a Charge against this Model's Unit, the Controlling Player may make a Willpower Check for this Model. If the Check is passed, the Charge Roll is made with a -2 modifier. This Model subtracts 1 from its Willpower Characteristic and 1 from its Leadership Characteristic.

rules.name: Executioner of Nostramo
rules.summary: Judgement is done in public, so that the city may learn from it.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Strength Characteristic and subtracts 2 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic. When this Model removes an enemy Character as a casualty, every enemy Unit within 12" must make a Cool Check, and a Unit that fails gains the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Sentence Passed
rules.summary: The verdict is read in the dark, and the accused hears it.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Shooting phase, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Unit within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule. That Unit must make a Cool Check, and gains the Suppressed Tactical Status if it fails.

rules.name: Wail of the Unforgiven
rules.summary: Nostramo's dying scream, worn on a face.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Assault phase, each enemy Unit within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule must make a Cool Check, and gains the Suppressed Tactical Status if it fails.

rites.name: Knives in the Dark
rites.flavor: The first sign is a sentry who does not answer the next call.
benefits: Night Raptor Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).

Night Raptors, Reconnaissance Squads and Scout Squads gain Shrouded (6+) and Silent Knives: they have the Outflank Special Rule, and enemy Units cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks against them during the Battle Turn they arrive from Reserves.
limitations: At least one Night Raptor Squad is required.
No Armour units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: Knives in the Dark: Silent Knives, Outflank, Shrouded (6+).

require.note: Bring at least one Night Raptor Squad.

rites.name: Dread Procession
rites.flavor: They did not need to win the battle if the enemy could be persuaded to lose it first.
benefits: Tactical, Despoiler, Veteran Tactical, Assault, Veteran Assault and Reconnaissance Squads gain Fear (1).
Those squads gain Dread Herald: each enemy Unit they charge subtracts a further 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of that Assault phase.
limitations: No Heavy sub-type Infantry (no Terminators, Breachers or Warders).
No Armour units and no Support units of any kind.

rites.name: Cabal of Murder
rites.flavor: Curze's trusted few do not take orders. They pass judgement on whoever gave them.
benefits: Contekar Terminator Squads and Atramentar Flay-clades may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Judgement of the Cabal: before Deployment, choose one enemy Unit as the Condemned; Hit Tests the Cabal makes against it are made with a +1 modifier.
limitations: Konrad Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
No Armour, Transport or Fast Attack units.

modifiers.text: Cabal of Murder: Line (1), Judgement of the Cabal.

require.note: Curze or Sevatar must lead the Cabal.

rites.name: The Headsman's Tithe
rites.flavor: A world pays in tithe, one way or another. The Eighth Legion simply prefers the other.
benefits: Terror Squads gain Fear (2) in place of Fear (1), and Tithe of Blood: when they destroy an enemy Unit in an Assault, each enemy Unit within 12" subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of the Battle Turn.
The Headsman adds 1 to his Attacks Characteristic.
limitations: Konrad Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
At least two Terror Squads are required.
No Praetors of any kind and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: The Headsman's Tithe: Fear (2), Tithe of Blood.

require.note: Bring at least two Terror Squads.
Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.

armyRules.name: Prey on the Weak
benefits: In the Assault phase, Hit Tests made by a Model with this Special Rule against an enemy Unit that has a Tactical Status are made with a +1 modifier.
drawbacks: If a Unit with this Special Rule is charged by an enemy Unit that has no Tactical Status, its Models subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic for that Assault.
armyRules.condition: vs enemy with a Tactical Status: +1 to Hit in the Assault phase

armyRules.name: Shadows of Nostramo
armyRules.flavor: Hunters who live in the dark, and fear the open field.
benefits: Shooting Attacks made against a Unit with this Special Rule from more than 18" away are made with a -1 modifier to the Hit Test.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks.

armyRules.name: Doom Foretold
armyRules.flavor: The Night Haunter's captains speak of judgement as if it were already written.
benefits: At the start of each Assault phase, the Controlling Player chooses one enemy Unit within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule. That Unit subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of the phase.
drawbacks: If a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty, each friendly Night Lords Unit within 12" must immediately make a Morale Check with a -1 modifier to its Leadership Characteristic.

armyRules.name: Verdict Foreseen
armyRules.flavor: He has already seen how this ends, and so has every man who follows him.
benefits: While Konrad Curze is on the battlefield, at the end of each Assault phase every enemy Unit that lost a Combat against a friendly Night Lords Infantry Unit within 18" of him must make a Cool Check, and gains the Pinned Tactical Status if it fails.
drawbacks: A friendly Night Lords Infantry Unit that declares a Charge against an enemy Unit with no Tactical Status subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Roll.
If Konrad Curze is removed as a casualty, every friendly Night Lords Unit within 18" of him gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.
